museum: Akoris archaeological site, Chapel E storeroom (Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities)
lead_detail: Shimizu 2026 (Orient 61: 109-125) n.7: 'Currently (in 2024) the crocodile mummies in Akoris are kept inside Chapel E'; Abou-Seif (1926) relocated crocodile mummies and coffins not needed by the Cairo Museum into Chapel E's second room (iron gate, storage). 2024 cleaning found numerous crocodile mummies incl. one with cranial length c. 69 cm, est. total length c. 4.8 m. Publication forthcoming: Shimizu, 'The Second Room of Chapel E at Akoris' (Preliminary Report Akoris).
notes: Japanese Akoris Archaeological Project (Kawanishi, Tsujimura, Hanasaka; Paleological Association of Japan). For egypt agent.
